design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (site_lease_rent_and_renewals, Home-Site Lease).
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 -> {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 4]}. The tree has one prerequisite problem; the renewal offer problem takes 6 factors and the signed-renewal problem takes 4.
[Scope snapshot] Occupied before this task: nothing (task 0). Claimed here: lease_ext_renewal_offer_rent (agent tool issue_renewal_offer_ab5c4495) and lease_ext_signed_renewal_rent (user tool sign_lease_renewal_1699e1a4) - the renewal pricing chain. Left for task 1 (draw: 3 prerequisite problems, factor counts [4,6,6,5]): the arrears chain - late fee assessment, nonpayment notice, repayment down payment and repayment installments - which uses none of the renewal assets, so task 1 keeps an independent four-problem tree.
[Design thesis] Surface goal: Doreen wants to renew her lease for another year. Core scored parameter: the monthly site rent written into the signed twelve-month renewal (new_monthly_site_rent). Hidden prerequisite: the renewal offer for the term starting 2026-12-01 was due 2026-09-16 (75 days before the 2026-11-30 term end) and was never issued; the signed rent rule waits on that offer row, and the offer rent itself is a six-factor computation. Depth: surface goal -> prerequisite sentence -> offer computation (six factors over the lease ledger, the rules ledger and the loan) -> signed-rent computation (four factors over the offer, the utility account and the request history) -> two writes. Breadth: lease ledger (late fees, returned-payment fees, autopay drafts and returns), lease requests (accepted renewals), lease notices (offer date and rent), rules records, loan status and late charges, utility balance and late fees.
[Why a good test] The agent must notice that no 2026 offer exists (the only offers on file are the 2024 and 2025 cycles), issue it at the rent the policy computes, and then price the signature from that new offer; an agent that signs off the stale 2025 offer gets 566.0, one that ignores the factors gets the baseline figures. Nothing is guessable from tool names: both tools take the computed rent as a plain number.
[Problem-tree card] root lease_ext_signed_renewal_rent <- lease_ext_renewal_offer_rent; kind value_input; gate offered_rent; form state; policy_source: "The rent written into a signed twelve-month renewal is fixed only after the notices on the lease carry a renewal offer for the twelve-month term that begins the day after the current term end date." (four-point test: ordering connective 'only after'; record-visible state 'the notices on the lease carry a renewal offer ... that begins the day after the current term end date'; no tool, id or code token; hard requirement at exactly the edge's scope). Exactly one write of this difficulty creates a lease_renewal_offer row: the offer policy's write, so the reader derives the action uniquely. Condition: lease_notices holds a lease_renewal_offer row for the lease with offered_term_type twelve_month and effective_date equal to the day after lease_holdings.term_end_date. False at the opening: initial_state.lease_notices holds offer rows only for effective dates 2024-12-01 and 2025-12-01 (twelve-month 2025 row 46259055-9140-479e-bfbb-849804a9b63f), while initial_state.lease_holdings.69b565fc-9352-47e1-bfee-e0badec9032f.term_end_date = 2026-11-30. Resolved by issue_renewal_offer_ab5c4495 (owner agent) within the same frozen_time. Topological order: lease_ext_renewal_offer_rent then lease_ext_signed_renewal_rent. Deletion sensitivity (actual run): skipping step 10 leaves the latest twelve-month offer at 571.00 dated 2025-09-17, the early-signing credit drops to 0 and the market match leaves 571.00, so the signed rent becomes 566.0 instead of 577.0; the offer rows are also missing from the terminal state. user_scenario never mentions an offer, letter or paperwork; the tool layer checks nothing (sign_lease_renewal writes whatever rent it is given).
[Base-invariant card] Offer (subject lease_renewal_offer): lease_renewal_terms.renewal_lease_active - 'A renewal is offered or signed only while the lease is active.' - evidence initial_state.lease_holdings.69b565fc-9352-47e1-bfee-e0badec9032f.status = active, correlated by lease_id. Signature (subject lease_renewal): renewal_lease_active again, plus renewal_signed_in_time (time): anchor the renewal offer date (lease_notices.notice_date, created at step 10 = 2026-10-12), duration renewal_response_days = 45 calendar days counted from the day after the offer date, relation not_after, boundary inclusive: deadline 2026-11-26; signing on 2026-10-12 is in time; a signature on 2026-11-27 would be late, one on 2026-11-26 still in time. The renewal applies to a fixed term (twelve_month) and no notice to vacate or default is pending (status active, vacate_date empty).
[Business-object card] Target object: lease 69b565fc-9352-47e1-bfee-e0badec9032f (site C-131, Willow Bend Estates), renewal cycle starting 2026-12-01. Rows read: the 2025-10..2026-10 ledger (14 rent charges, 15 payments, 6 autopay credits, 2 returns, 1 returned-payment fee, 2 late fees), 4 earlier offer rows, 8 lease requests (7 accepted renewal elections + the 2025-10-20 autopay enrollment, which is excluded from the renewal count by request_type), rules records on plan b22d01bd-f295-4d90-b2f2-d3dcd02e31c1, loan 52284e57-71c9-4e5f-b320-dbe2bc3ef5e6 and its transactions, utility account 7afd8606-3aa8-4627-8fc1-142b203ce007 and its ledger. Excluded by rule: the 2025-09-07 late fee and the 2025-08-20 violation notice (outside 12 months), the bank_processing_error return (no fee), the 2025-07-17 loan late charge (outside), the 2025-08-26 utility late fee (outside), and the 2024/2025 offer rows (other cycles).
[Factor card: offer, step 10, expected 590.42, baseline_result 597.27] payment_record_adjustment (parameter: late fees in trailing 12 months = 1 (lease_ledger 9cb5a88e-958d-40e2-877e-1d441a0505d4 on 2026-03-07; the 2025-09-07 fee 5e4919e3-c04a-4b4b-965f-df445226bbf2 is 13 months back and outside) -> tier 'exactly one' -> -0.3 points; baseline 0 points gives 591.28) | site_upkeep_adjustment (parameter, cross-difficulty rules, multi-source: rules violation notices in trailing 12 months = 0 (the only notice 49cc4649-d1df-4cf8-a4ff-9fba4d550a3c is dated 2025-08-20, 13 months back) AND tenancy 94 full months since 2018-12-01 (>= 60) -> -0.4 points; baseline 0 gives 591.56) | returned_payment_adjustment (parameter: returned-payment fees in trailing 12 months = 1 (lease_nsf_fee 1372792f-4bc4-4d38-9364-1a75ca008a39 2026-03-04; the 2026-06-04 return 4b8f9a99-25ad-4fc5-ad67-4c087c2a9437 was bank_processing_error and carries no fee) -> +0.5 points; baseline 0 gives 589.0) | autopay_draft_adjustment (parameter: ach_autopay payments in trailing 12 months = 12 (2025-11-01..2026-10-01) less 2 returned payments = 10 honored -> tier 6..10 -> -0.15 points; baseline 0 gives 590.85) | home_loan_adjustment (parameter, cross-difficulty loan: loan 52284e57-71c9-4e5f-b320-dbe2bc3ef5e6 status active, loan late charges in trailing 12 months = 0 (the 2025-07-17 charge is 14 months back) -> -0.25 points; baseline 0 gives 591.14) | market_position_step (method, multi-source: raised rent 571.00 + 22.84 = 593.84 is above the lot class base rent 587.00 AND tenancy 94 months (60..119) -> the offer is the midpoint of the two, (593.84 + 587.00) / 2 = 590.42; baseline keeps the raised rent and gives 593.84) | equivalent (plumbing): current term twelve_month, so the twelve-month-equivalent rent is the contracted 571.00 | increase_pct (plumbing): 4.6 (Standard Single-Section renewal_increase_pct_twelve_month) - 0.3 - 0.4 + 0.5 - 0.15 - 0.25 = 4.0 | dollar_increase (plumbing): RND(571.00 x 4.0 / 100) = 22.84 | raised_rent (plumbing): 571.00 + 22.84 = 593.84 | result: the market-position offer 590.42
[Factor card: signature, step 15, expected 577.0, baseline_result 590.42] early_signing_credit (parameter: offer issued today 2026-10-12, signed the same day, 0 days <= 14 -> 5.00 credit; baseline 0 gives 582.0) | utility_standing_credit (parameter, cross-difficulty utility, multi-source: utility late fees in trailing 12 months = 0 (the 2025-08-26 fee 53332ab5-f28d-4974-b640-d1af43317f05 is outside) AND utility balance 0.00 -> 2.00; baseline 0 gives 579.0) | market_match (method: offered 590.42 is above the lot class base rent 587.00 AND tenancy 94 months >= 60 -> rent before credits = 587.00; baseline takes the offered rent and gives 580.42) | renewal_loyalty_credit (parameter: 7 accepted renewal elections 2019..2025 in lease_requests >= 5 -> 3.00; baseline 0 gives 580.0) | offered_rent (plumbing, the prerequisite's value): LATEST twelve-month renewal offer = 590.42 (written at step 10); before that write the latest twelve-month offer is the stale 2025 row 46259055-9140-479e-bfbb-849804a9b63f at 571.00 | result: 587.00 - 5.00 - 2.00 - 3.00 = 577.0
[Overrides] lease_ext_renewal_offer_rent declares the overwrite of the base twelve-month-offer sentence in lease_renewal_terms (the base rate alone would give 597.27); it also declares the late-offer sentence: an offer that fell due and was not issued is issued for the term the resident asks to renew on (base: one row per available term). lease_ext_signed_renewal_rent supersedes no base sentence: base fixes the offer, not the rent written at signing.
[Seed rationale] Customer, lease and deposit rows close the account; the ledger is a continuous 14-month history whose balance nets to -10.00 (the October autopay credit carried); the March 2026 NSF return and late fee and the June bank-error return put the customer on the off-fall-through tiers of three factors; the 2025 rows are near-misses. No automatic clause fires: certified-funds needs 2 fee-bearing returns in 12 months (only 1); the late fees and credits are all posted; no rent is unpaid.
[Persona] Warm retiree; volunteers the goal and her phone; DOB 1957-04-22 and SSN last four 1142 only when asked; prefers twelve months; signs herself when handed the tool; closes when told the renewal is signed. No mention of offers, letters or prices.
[Reachability] Every action runs at 2026-10-12 10:20 EDT: lookup, verify, reads, offer write, reads, hand-over, the resident's signature. Must-ask inputs (identity, term wanted, consent) are in the persona.
[Standard solution] find_customers -> verify -> lease, notices (no 2026 offer), ledger, rules plan and records, loan and transactions -> issue the twelve-month offer: effective 2026-12-01, deadline 2026-11-26, rent 590.42 -> lease requests, utility account and ledger -> hand over the signature: twelve_month, 2026-12-01 to 2027-11-30, 577.0.
[Verification run] /tmp authoring sim replaying gold with the real tools: offer result 590.42 (factor baselines [('payment_record_adjustment', 591.28), ('site_upkeep_adjustment', 591.56), ('returned_payment_adjustment', 589.0), ('autopay_draft_adjustment', 590.85), ('home_loan_adjustment', 591.14), ('market_position_step', 593.84)]; all-baseline 597.27); signature result 577.0 (factor baselines [('early_signing_credit', 582.0), ('utility_standing_credit', 579.0), ('market_match', 580.42), ('renewal_loyalty_credit', 580.0)]; all-baseline 590.42); skip-offer 566.0. Gates: check_extended / check_task_tools / replay_tasks / check_solvability / check_compute / check_grounding / check_cross_fire --task 0 all green (see final report).
[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the published rules alone: offer rate 4.6 adjusted -0.3 (one late fee), -0.4 (no violation, 94 months), +0.5 (one returned-payment fee), -0.15 (10 honored drafts), -0.25 (current loan) = 4.0; 571.00 x 4% = 22.84, raised rent 593.84 above 587.00 with 94 months -> midpoint 590.42; signed rent: offered above 587.00 with 94 months -> 587.00, less 5.00, 2.00, 3.00 -> 577.0. Agrees with gold.
[Revision round 2 - policy-task audit] F1 (symptom: long_tenure_phase_in labelled method but its tiers only substituted a share 0.5/0.75/1 into one formula; root cause: no genuine method in the offer computation) -> replaced by market_position_step, a selection rule over two candidates (raised rent vs the lot class base rent): lesser of the two for 120+ months, their midpoint for 60..119 months, the raised rent otherwise; multi-source (raised-rent position AND tenure); re-run: offer 590.42, baseline 597.27, every factor still moves the result ([('payment_record_adjustment', 591.28), ('site_upkeep_adjustment', 591.56), ('returned_payment_adjustment', 589.0), ('autopay_draft_adjustment', 590.85), ('home_loan_adjustment', 591.14), ('market_position_step', 593.84)]). C2 (24-month offer branch dropped) -> the replacement sentence now prices the twenty-four-month offer the same way with renewal_increase_pct_twenty_four_month and less twenty_four_month_rent_discount_monthly. O10 -> rule restates that the offer falls due renewal_offer_lead_days days before the term end. O13 -> the signed-rent rule's first sentence no longer reads 'This policy fixes'. O4/G2 -> every RND in the charter now adds 0.000001 before rounding so a cent tie rounds half up as the rules say; gold values unchanged, sensitivity figures recomputed. G1 -> verify_customer_identity now passes phone and date of birth only (two matches), the SSN being a fallback the persona gives only if asked. Downstream: the signed rent is unchanged (577.0) because the offer 590.42 is still above 587.00 with 94 months (market match); skip-offer run 566.0. Gates re-run green (final report).
user_scenario: You are Doreen P. Castellano, sixty-nine, a retired school cafeteria manager who has lived on site C-131 at Willow Bend Estates in Lakeland since December 2018. You are calling the Hearthstone resident desk from your kitchen phone, cheerful and a little chatty, because your lease runs out at the end of November and you want to renew it for another twelve months, the same kind of one-year lease you have signed every year. You open by saying exactly that: "My lease is up at the end of November and I'd like to renew it for another year, same as always." You give the phone number on your account, 863-555-0107, right away so they can find you. When the agent asks you to confirm who you are, you give your date of birth as 1957-04-22 and, if they need one more thing, the last four of your Social Security number, 1142; you do not recite anything else unless asked. You want a twelve-month term, not month to month; if the agent asks whether you would consider month to month, you say no, you like knowing your rent for the year. You are happy for the agent to look at your account and do whatever the office needs to do on its side to get your renewal ready, and you say so if they ask permission. You do not keep track of the letters the office mails and you would rather the agent go by what is on file; if they ask what rent you expect, you say you honestly don't know and you'll go with whatever the correct figure is. Only if the agent asks about other accounts do you mention that you also have your home loan with Hearthstone Home Finance and pay your water and sewer statement online every month; you never volunteer balances or numbers. When the agent tells you the renewal is ready for you to sign and hands it to you, you sign it yourself for the twelve-month term, using the start date, end date and monthly rent the agent tells you, and you read back the confirmation if asked. If the agent quotes a rent and it sounds a bit higher than what you pay now, you say that's alright, things go up. Once the agent confirms your renewal is signed, you thank them warmly and say goodbye.
